entities.name: Carmen Argibay
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carmen María Argibay was a member of the Supreme Court of Argentina. She was the first woman to be nominated for the Court by a democratic government in Argentina, and caused some controversy upon declaring herself an atheist and a supporter of legal abortion.
